acceptance_criteria.requirement: The exact Part 2 merged-main commit, tree, completion receipt, governance, and all predecessor gates are independently reverified before Stage 6 changes.
Managed-run, task, completion, plan, lease, cost, inventory, and object-authority contracts are versioned, canonical, bounded, and fail closed.
Expected outputs and admission decisions are frozen independently from primitive inputs before any managed output can exist.
Every input and output is bound to exact bucket, key, version, checksum, manifest, source, definition, cutoff, and run identities.
The Glue entry point executes the verified bitemporal five-feature computation under explicit row, runtime, concurrency, and output limits.
The online path preserves candidate isolation, exact reconciliation, independent parity, conditional activation, and generation-pinned serving semantics.
Retries, task identities, object identities, DynamoDB conditions, and completion receipts make restart and lost-acknowledgement behavior fail closed.
The Step Functions graph contains real Lambda and Glue integrations, explicit retries, quarantine, and no placeholder states.
Runtime artifacts are allowlisted, deterministic, content-addressed, size-bounded, and free of credentials, tests, caches, state, and local paths.
Terraform, providers, and GitHub actions are exactly pinned; formatting, clean initialization, provider locking, validation, provenance, checksum, and license gates pass.
S3, DynamoDB, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch, KMS, and catalog resources form one minimal deployable bounded-run graph.
Encryption, public-access blocking, PITR, retention, disabled scheduling, concurrency one, and log redaction defaults are enforced by configuration.
Runtime and plan-only IAM is least privilege; OIDC binds the exact repository, audience, and protected environment; unavoidable wildcard reads are documented.
The authorized AWS account, role, region, namespace inventory, service availability, and quotas are qualified using only the enumerated read APIs.
The project-neutral exclusive lease is current, FeatureForge-owned, commit-bound, heartbeat-bounded, and rejects absent, conflicting, or expired state.
The exact planned configuration has a current price basis, budget headroom, USD 25 ceiling, and mandatory twenty-percent safety margin.
A refresh-aware saved Terraform plan is bound to source, variables, providers, state lineage and serial, account, region, artifacts, inventory, lease, and expiry.
The normalized plan contains only allowlisted create/update/read actions, no unexplained replacement or deletion, and an independently reviewed cleanup inverse.
Command and API receipts prove that Stage 6 performed no Terraform apply, destroy, import, state mutation, AWS write, or managed workload.
Wrong account, region, source, artifact, variables, provider lock, state, lease, inventory, quota, cost, and expired-plan controls all reject before mutation.
Public evidence is deterministic, digest-indexed, sanitized, and contains no secrets, account IDs, sensitive ARNs or URLs, local paths, binary state, or other-project content.
All Stage 0-5 quality, proof, claim, and evidence gates remain unchanged and green.
The unchanged reviewed head passes required CI and review governance, merges by expected head, and merged main is independently reproduced.
An external continuation receipt binds all identities, versions, evidence, limitations, plan expiry, and FEATUREFORGE_STAGE6_AWS_PLAN_VERIFIED.
